summary: Tested the EMA 10/20 EXPERIMENTAL test strategy ported to the HotForex (/api/fx) and Pepperstone (/api/pepper) bots. Engine pytest file test_iter83 plus regressions iter82 and iter79: 64/64 pass. New API file test_iter84 (settings GET/PUT, symbol cleanup and de-duplication, fx/pepper independence, ADX 5-60 bounds returning 422, meta strategies vs strategy_keys, ema_test backtest reasons and partial flag, Bybit regression): 14/14 pass. Manual check: with sessions_allowed=['sydney'], the ema_test backtest still has skipped_session=0 (27 trades, reasons CRUCE/SL/FIN_SEMANA), while trend_ema skips 7, so the session filter still applies to the other strategies. ADX filter settings reach the backtest (ADX min 33 cut trades from 27 to 1). UI: on /pepperstone and /hotforex the ema-test card shows the FX warning text, 12 chips, the chip toggle, the enabled switch, and the ADX switch that reveals the min input. Saving persisted on pepper only; fx and bybit were unchanged. The Backtest tab offers 'Test cruce EMA 10/20' and runs without errors on EURUSD. Bybit still shows its own card (18 chips, no FX session text). All settings were restored.

issues: The default pair XAUUSD gives 0 trades with 'Test cruce EMA 10/20' on 1h with $500 capital: all 43 signals are rejected below the minimum lot because the 3×ATR SL is wide. XAUUSD is also in the default ema_test_symbols, so live/paper test entries on gold will probably also be refused at this capital. Consider a note or a different default.

ADX mínimo outside 5-60 (e.g. 70) is not clamped like the other numeric fields; the save fails with the toast 'Valor inválido en: ema_test_adx_min' (a 422). This is acceptable but inconsistent with the clamping of the other NUMS fields.

action_items: Optional: clamp ema_test_adx_min to 5-60 in SettingsPanel save (or add it to the NUMS clamping) instead of relying on the 422 toast
Optional: warn that XAUUSD ema_test trades may be rejected below the minimum lot with small accounts (3×ATR SL)
critical_code_review_comments: EmaTestSettings sends ema_test_adx_min as a string from the input (e.target.value); pydantic converts it, but an empty input gives '' and then a 422. Cast it with Number() before saving.
seed_data_creation: None. Settings on fx and pepper were temporarily changed (ema_test_*, sessions_allowed) and restored to the originals: enabled false, symbols EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY/XAUUSD, adx_filter false, adx_min 20, sessions_allowed [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: The forex market was closed (weekend), so live engine behaviour is covered only by the monkeypatched test_iter83. Backtest responses are flat (no 'result' key). Run the API tests with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported and -n 0. Bots were never started.
